auto.title: Maker shadow READY -- run maker_estimator.py
auto.description: Fix 10 (maker orders) Phase 1 running SHADOW since 2026-06-29: every YES/NO entry logs a would-be resting-limit (maker) order alongside the real FOK -- ZERO real maker orders. Gate is COUNT-based, not calendar: per-trade fill-rate/edge needs a sample size, not a clock (a quiet week of 6 trades proves nothing); a secondary spread check flags a few-day/few-city sample as a possible regime artifact. At 40 logged rows run: python3 maker_estimator.py -- Layer 1 fill-rate bracket + price improvement (needs ~40 logged); Layer 2 adverse-selection win-rate filled-vs-missed; Layer 3 net-PnL taker-all vs maker-first+fallback (needs ~30 RESOLVED rows). Only if maker-first beats taker-all AND not adversely selected -> Phase 2 live canary (ASK DCP first).

auto.title: Maker canary has NO FLOW -- live but 0 orders ever posted (supply problem, not a fill-rate problem)
auto.description: Fix 10 Phase 2 canary: maker-first entries (resting GTD post_only, taker fallback, never pure-maker) on nyc, london, shanghai, shenzhen, chongqing, chengdu, moscow. Own budget maker_live_cap=10 counted as fills+in-flight -- NOT the shared live_test_cap, so the paused Gaussian taker book neither blocks it nor is unblocked by it. Posted 0 | filled 0 | resting 0. ZERO posted while live means the path is UNREACHABLE (no eligible entries): check that the canary cities actually generate Gaussian YES/NO entries >6h from resolution -- NR entries never route maker. At 20 fills run python3 maker_estimator.py and compare realized fill-rate + maker-first-vs-taker delta to the shadow estimate (n=47: +$0.0706/row, CI [+0.034,+0.119], adverse -32pp). Realized delta<0 or fill-rate far below estimate -> pull back (maker_apply_mode=shadow + restart). Holds -> widen maker_canary_cities / raise maker_live_cap. Always check data/maker_halt.flag (D3 hard-stop fired = review before re-arming).
